purpose: the one-shot E-08 audit of the frozen structural estimator on the 128 sealed audit houses

why_a_separate_contract.reason: D-219 governs E-06 and correctly lists audit_open_or_generation in its must_remain_false; opening the audit from inside D-219 would defeat the gate that keeps training from reading it

frozen_model_binding.note: the audit evaluates exactly the E-06 weights; any byte change refuses the run

audit_sample.source: the D-221 extended prefix, audit rank 0..127 in the frozen hash order

seal_extension.reason: D-221's prefix extension rewrote only the train and calibration plan rows, so the audit seal stayed at the original 64 while the contracts said 128; the extension uses the same fixed hash prefix and the original 64 must remain the leading entries

frozen_metric_definitions.probabilities: the frozen structural head logits divided by the frozen temperature, then softmax

structural_nll.definition: mean over audit observations of the negative natural log of the probability assigned to the private reference class

structural_accuracy.definition: fraction of audit observations whose argmax class equals the private reference class
structural_accuracy.argmax_tie_policy: lowest class index wins, recorded as a tie count

calibration_error.definition: expected calibration error over the maximum class probability
calibration_error.bin_edges: equal width over the closed interval 0 to 1
calibration_error.weighting: bin observation count divided by total observations

per_class_interval.interval: house level cluster bootstrap percentile interval

per_house_interval.interval: house level cluster bootstrap percentile interval

bootstrap.method: resample houses with replacement, keeping every observation of a resampled house
bootstrap.rationale: observations inside one house are correlated, so the interval must be taken over houses and not over frames

reported_but_not_a_gate.note: the audit describes the frozen front-end; it does not decide whether the paper proceeds
